page_title: LAZ 0-1 ROM | Lazio v AS Roma 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Pointless reaction! Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) receives a red card for unsporting behaviour after the final whistle.
90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
90+2' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and it's Taty Castellanos (Lazio) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.

90' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header would probably have ended up low inside the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
88' Mario Gila (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
85' Reda Belahyane (Lazio) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
85' Reda Belahyane (Lazio) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Substitution. Angelino will be replaced by Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma).
81' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Bryan Cristante and he is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
79' Tijjani Noslin comes onto the pitch because Pedro (Lazio) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
76' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
75' Angelino (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
73' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) replaces Matias Soule.
73' Substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini makes his way off the pitch and Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) comes on as his replacement.
70' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
70' The resulting corner from Pedro (Lazio) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
68' The game is interrupted. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
66' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Evan Ferguson will be replaced by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
64' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
62' Substitution. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) in, Boulaye Dia out.
61' Corner kick. Matias Soule (AS Roma) is ready to send the ball into the box.
59' Pedro (Lazio) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
58' Matias Soule (AS Roma) whips in a cross from the corner, but Ivan Provedel is well positioned and punches the ball away.

58' Matias Soule (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Flag goes up against Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
54' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
54' Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
51' Simone Sozza blows his whistle. Reda Belahyane (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' Ivan Provedel comes off his line to intercept the corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
50' Close! Angelino (AS Roma) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
49' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Dangerous play by Evan Ferguson (AS Roma). Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is replaced by Luca Pellegrini.
46' Maurizio Sarri has made a change at the break. Danilo Cataldi has come on in place of Nicolo Rovella (Lazio).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Simone Sozza has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Matias Soule (AS Roma) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

45+3' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Ivan Provedel, who pulls off a decent save! The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.

45+1' This was a piece of cake for Ivan Provedel. Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Matias Soule (AS Roma) will deliver the corner kick.
45' The ball is cleared after Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. AS Roma earn a corner.
43' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
42' Angelino (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement.
41' Matias Soule (AS Roma) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Ivan Provedel.
40' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! AS Roma get a free kick.
39' Neat passing move from AS Roma in order to create new attacking opportunities. The ball possession at the moment is 46:54.

38' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Matias Soule, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), who beats Ivan Provedel with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 0:1.
36' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is able to continue to play.
34' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

33' A fine solo run by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
32' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
32' The game is interrupted now, Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' The corner is sent into the box by Pedro, but Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) flashes the ball just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
30' Pedro (Lazio) will take the corner.

29' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
25' The referee blows for a cooling break.

23' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
22' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
22' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
20' Adam Marusic (Lazio) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
17' Pedro (Lazio) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
16' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Simone Sozza stops the game and makes a call.
14' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru is substituted due to injury. Maurizio Sarri gives a chance to Reda Belahyane (Lazio).
12' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is caught offside!

10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
9' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
8' One of the AS Roma players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
7' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bryan Cristante (AS Roma).
5' Lazio are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' The linesman signals that Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Simone Sozza is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
